description: Proposals only: Renovate opens the pull request, a person merges it after the drivers are green, and each machine still takes it through deploy/deploy.sh — nothing here deploys, and deploy/ci-freshness.sh says how stale a pin is whether or not the proposal was opened.

packageRules.description: The two ACP adapters, one pull request each: a bump is measured adapter by adapter against the daemon's own readers before package.json moves, and pnpm pincheck names every other place the version is written.
Everything else the root, control-plane and web manifests depend on, minors and patches grouped into one weekly proposal so a person reviews one diff rather than twenty.
A major is never grouped: each one is its own proposal with its own changelog to read.

Not the pnpm pin. deploy/bootstrap.sh installs the pnpm the root manifest's packageManager names and deploycheck asserts the two agree, so a proposal that moved only the manifest would be red by construction — moving it is a two-file edit a person makes.
